title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack: 

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

- Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

- DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required: 

- Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

- Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

- Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

- Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

- Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

- Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

- Languages : English. German is a big plus.

- Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

- Availability : 100%, as soon as possible.

- Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred: 

- Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

- Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

- Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset: 

- Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

- Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

- Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

- About you: A short description of yourself.

- Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

- Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

- Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

- Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

Job Description

RECO is actief in de verhuur en dienstverlening rondom de bouwplaats, onder andere op het gebied van tijdelijke huisvesting, energie, verlichting, steigerbouw, verticaal transport en bouwplaatsbeveiliging.

De bouwplaats wordt steeds digitaler. Data, IoT, AI, SaaS-oplossingen, sensoren en realtime monitoring bieden mogelijkheden om niet alleen afzonderlijke producten digitaal te ondersteunen, maar de 

bouwplaats als geheel slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter te maken.

Wat ga je doen? 

Hoe kan RECO een schaalbaar digitaal platform/concept ontwikkelen waarmee bouwplaatsen integraal digitaal kunnen worden gemonitord, aangestuurd en geoptimaliseerd, waarbij SaaS, AI, IoT en bestaande RECO-diensten samenkomen? 

Daarbij staat niet één afzonderlijk product centraal, maar de vraag: 

Hoe ziet de bouwplaats van de toekomst eruit en welke digitale rol kan RECO daarin vervullen? 

Het doel is om een conceptueel uitgewerkt en onderbouwd digitaliseringsconcept op te leveren dat RECO kan gebruiken als basis voor verdere ontwikkeling en eventuele realisatie. De opdracht moet nadrukkelijk voorkomen dat er alleen een theoretisch adviesrapport ontstaat.

Je wordt uitgedaagd om hands-on met technologie te werken en waar mogelijk een werkend prototype of proof-of-concept te ontwikkelen.

Requirements

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 HBO opleding in Software Development of Engineering, ICT, Technische Informatica, Business IT & Management, AI & Data Science of Applied Data Science

👍 Analytisch sterk met een ondernemende instelling;

👍 Interesse in AI, SaaS en cloud

👍 Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling;

👍 Kunnen vertalen van klantproblemen naar digitale oplossingen;

👍 Zelfstandig onderzoek kunnen uitvoeren;

👍 Bereidheid om een prototype daadwerkelijk te bouwen.

👍 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: 

✅ Een goede stagevergoeding.

✅ Begeleiding door ervaren professionals, dicht bij de business.

✅ Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en onderzoek.

✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie, iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, korte lijnen en een werksfeer waar je zo binnenloopt. Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze .

Over RECO 

RECOis dé specialist in het verhuren van bouwplaats materialen voor uiteenlopende projecten in de bouw, infra, renovatie, overheid en evenementen. Met een aanpakkers mentaliteit en betrokken collega’s werken we samen aan slimme materieeloplossingen.

Ben jij een ondernemende manager die energie krijgt van groei, techniek én mensen? Iemand die graag de lijnen uitzet, kansen ziet en ervoor zorgt dat plannen ook daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor je. 

Jouw baan als BU Manager Bouwmaterieel & Verticaal Transport bij RECO

Als Manager Bouwmaterieel & Verticaal Transport ben jij de spil binnen onze business unit voor tijdelijke verhuuroplossingen op de bouw. Denk aan steiger- en ondersteuningsconstructies en (bouw)liften. Jij krijgt de ruimte én verantwoordelijkheid om deze business verder op te bouwen, te professionaliseren en te laten groeien.

Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie en praktijk. De ene dag zit je met een opdrachtgever om tafel om een nieuwe samenwerking uit te bouwen, de volgende dag bespreek je met je team de voortgang van een uitdagend project. Jij houdt overzicht, neemt beslissingen en zorgt dat commercie, operatie en techniek goed op elkaar aansluiten.

Wat ga je doen: 

🛠️ Team & operatie aansturen 
Je geeft richting aan het team, creëert duidelijkheid en zorgt dat iedereen optimaal kan presteren. Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en weet mensen mee te krijgen.

📋 Projecten van A tot Z bewaken 
Je houdt grip op planning, uitvoering, kwaliteit en financiën. Je ziet waar kansen of risico's liggen en stuurt bij voordat het een probleem wordt.

🤝 Bouwen aan klanten en relaties 
Je onderhoudt bestaande relaties en gaat actief op zoek naar nieuwe opdrachtgevers en samenwerkingen. Je begrijpt wat er speelt bij klanten en weet dit te vertalen naar slimme oplossingen.

🔧 Techniek & inhoud 
Je hoeft niet ieder boutje zelf vast te draaien, maar je hebt voldoende technische kennis en interesse om mee te denken over complexe vraagstukken en praktische oplossingen, of bent bereid dit te leren.

📈 Groeien én verbeteren 
Je bouwt verder aan de business unit en brengt structuur, schaalbaarheid en professionaliteit. Je optimaliseert processen, signaleert verbeterpunten en zorgt ervoor dat we steeds slimmer gaan werken.

Requirements

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 Fulltime (40 uur p.w.) beschikbaar;

👍 Ervaring in een leidinggevende, commerciële of operationele functie binnen de bouw, verhuur, materieel of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving.

👍 Een ondernemende instelling: je ziet kansen en komt in beweging.

👍 Sterke communicatieve en organisatorische vaardigheden.

👍 Affiniteit met bouwmaterieel, steigerbouw, ondersteuning en/of verticaal transport.

👍 Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit en samenwerking niet uit het oog.

👍 Je kunt goed schakelen tussen klant, collega, project en directie.

👍 Je houdt van verantwoordelijkheid en krijgt energie van bouwen aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is. 

Waarom deze functie?

Omdat je bij ons niet in een gespreid bedje terechtkomt.

Je krijgt juist de kans om ondernemend te bouwen aan een business unit, samen met een team dat vooruit wil. Je hebt invloed op de koers, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en volop mogelijkheden om processen, mensen en resultaten naar een hoger niveau te brengen.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, korte lijnen, technische uitdagingen en de vrijheid om écht verschil te maken.

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: 

✅ Een goed salaris;

✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waardering voor geen ziekteverzuim;

✅ Een fijne, volledig ingerichte werkplek waar jij je snel thuis voelt;

✅ Daarnaast krijg je een telefoon en laptop van de zaak, zodat je goed van start kunt.

✅ Een collectieve zorgverzekering én goede pensioenregeling met maar 3,3% eigen bijdrage, de rest betaalt RECO;

✅ Veel opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via onze RECO Academy;

✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie: iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, de lijnen zijn kort en je loopt gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnen. Daarnaast organiseren we een goed verzorgde zomerbarbecue en een groots eindejaarspersoneelsfeest! Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze .

Over RECO 

RECOis dé specialist in het verhuren van bouwplaats materialen voor uiteenlopende projecten in de bouw, infra, renovatie, overheid en evenementen. Met een aanpakkers mentaliteit en betrokken collega’s werken we samen aan slimme materieeloplossingen.

title: Netwerk Engineer Telecom
description:
Over Maxitel 

Bij Maxitel geloven ze dat zakelijke communicatie meer is dan alleen telefonie. Zij helpen organisaties met slimme oplossingen op het gebied van VoIP, mobiele telefonie, internet, glasvezel, IoT en connectiviteit. Daarbij leveren ze geen standaardproducten, maar maatwerk dat past bij de manier waarop hun klanten werken. Omdat Maxitel groeit en grotere klanten en projecten binnenhaalt, zoeken ze een Network Engineer die dit netwerk mee beheert en verder bouwt.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Network Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de techniek achter de diensten van Maxitel. Je werkt vanaf kantoor in Alphen aan den Rijn, nauw samen met de senior netwerkspecialist. Geen dag is hetzelfde. 

Jouw werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

- Beheren, configureren en uitbreiden van coreswitches en routers.

- Onderhouden van het ringnetwerk en bewaken van de redundantie.

- Aanvragen, inregelen en beheren van glasvezelverbindingen, in afstemming met leveranciers.

- Inrichten en beheren van datacenterkoppelingen en peering, in afstemming met datacenters en partners.

- Oplossen van storingen tot op de bodem, inclusief een structurele oplossing.

- Meedenken over de architectuur van het netwerk nu Maxitel doorgroeit.

- Documenteren van configuraties en netwerkschema's.

- Oppakken van andere technische vraagstukken die op je pad komen, samen met collega's van support en sales.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken wij? 

Maxitel zoekt een ervaren netwerkengineer die het netwerk echt begrijpt. Niet alleen hoe je iets instelt, maar ook waarom het werkt zoals het werkt. Je hebt dit al een aantal jaren gedaan en werkt zelfstandig. Wie een netwerk goed doorgrondt, pakt ook andere technische zaken makkelijk op. Die brede instelling zoeken ze.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

- Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau.

- Je hebt een aantal jaren ervaring als netwerkengineer, bij voorkeur bij een ISP, telecombedrijf of datacenter.

- Je hebt stevige kennis van routing en switching: BGP, OSPF, VLAN's en bij voorkeur MPLS.

- Je kent redundante netwerkontwerpen zoals ringtopologieën.

- Je hebt ervaring met het configureren van apparatuur van bijvoorbeeld Cisco of Juniper.

- Een certificering zoals CCNA, CCNP of JNCIA is mooi meegenomen.

- Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en kunt de techniek overnemen als dat nodig is.

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend. Engels is mooi meegenomen.

Benefits

Wat krijg je ervoor terug? 

Bij Maxitel kom je terecht in een klein en betrokken team waar iedereen elkaar kent. Er zijn geen ingewikkelde managementlagen, waardoor je veel vrijheid krijgt om mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Je kunt rekenen op:

- Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

- Een sleutelrol in een eigen netwerk, met directe impact.

- Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

- Een informeel team met korte lijnen.

- Opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen die aansluiten op jouw ambities.

- Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

- Re i

Enthousiast? 

Lijkt het je leuk om het netwerk van Maxitel mee te bouwen en te beheren? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
Are you a creative and proactive marketing student who wants to build a brand and tell the story behind innovative sustainable technology? At Thermeleon, we're looking for a Marketing & Branding Intern to help shape our brand identity, create engaging content, and increase our visibility in the greenhouse horticulture sector.

Our product, the Thermeleon Heat Battery, is an innovative day-night buffer for greenhouses. It improves energy efficiency by strategically reusing surplus heat, reducing natural gas consumption and supporting the transition towards climate-neutral horticulture.

As a Marketing & Branding Intern, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a wide range of marketing activities, from developing our new brand identity to creating visual content, managing our LinkedIn presence, and communicating our latest developments. You'll work closely with the team to translate complex technology into clear, engaging stories.

Taken

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Branding & Brand Identity: Contribute to the development and implementation of our new branding, ensuring a consistent and recognizable identity across all communication channels.

- Marketing Materials: Design and develop marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers, business cards, and other visual assets.

- Content Creation: Create engaging content for LinkedIn, newsletters, our website, and other communication channels to share company updates, projects, and innovations.

- Photography & Videography: Organize and produce visual content, including professional photography, drone footage, team photos, and project shoots at greenhouse locations.

- Social Media Management: Develop and maintain a content calendar, manage our LinkedIn presence, and identify opportunities to increase our reach and engagement.

- Website & Communication: Contribute to improving our website and ensure our messaging is clear, consistent, and aligned with our brand identity.

- Marketing Strategy: Identify creative ways to increase brand awareness, communicate our impact, and position Thermeleon within the sustainable energy and greenhouse horticulture sectors.

Vereisten

- You're currently studying towards a degree in Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Media, Design, or a related field.
- You have a strong interest in branding, content creation, and digital marketing. You have an eye for design, visual storytelling, and detail.
- You're comfortable creating content for social media, particularly LinkedIn. Experience with design and content creation tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or Figma is a plus.
- You have excellent communication skills in English. Dutch is a plus.
- You're creative, proactive, and enjoy taking ownership of projects from idea to execution.
- You're comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment where priorities can evolve and there's room to experiment.Affinity with sustainability, technology, and innovation is a plus.

Benefits

- The opportunity to shape and develop the brand identity of a growing sustainable technology company.
- Creative freedom and ownership over marketing projects, from the initial concept to the final result.
- Hands-on experience with branding, content creation, social media, and marketing strategy.
- The opportunity to create real-world content, including photography and drone footage at high-tech greenhouse locations.
- A close look into startup life, working directly with the founders and a multidisciplinary team.
- Room to experiment with new ideas, develop your skills, and make a visible impact.
- An internship allowance of €400 per month.

OUR TEAM

Thermeleon consists of an enthusiastic and diverse team driven by a sustainable vision and a passion for greenhouse horticulture. We're currently in the startup phase, with measurements and demonstrations at client greenhouses in full swing.

To keep learning from each other, we organize a weekly 'Therming Session' every Friday to share knowledge and wrap up the week together.

We're part of the European Union's Climate-KIC sustainable startup innovation program and receive funding from the NWO domain Applied and Engineering Sciences (TTW), in collaboration with TU Delft.

WORK LOCATION

Our office is located in the monumental Van Nelle Factory in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

DIVERSITY

We strive for diversity within our team, including education, background, specialization, and gender balance. Research shows that men often feel confident enough to apply when they meet 60% of the requirements, while women tend to apply only when they meet every criterion. So, if this role sounds like a good fit but you're not entirely sure you meet all the requirements, we'd still love to hear from you!

title: Merchant Growth Specialist
description:
Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel.

Full-time

About SOUS 

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role 

Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. You dive into each merchant's online performance, find the biggest opportunities and help them capture them. What you learn flows straight back into our product and playbooks.

Your team 

You are part of the Growth team and work closely with the Growth Lead and our product team. You work hand in hand with Merchant Success, who own the day-to-day relationship with our merchants.

Tasks

Your focus 

- Drive measurable revenue growth for our merchants

- Optimise merchant revenue on Uber Eats and Just Eat Takeaway

- Grow the share of direct orders through SOUS Commerce and visibility through Spotlight

- Turn what works into repeatable growth playbooks and product input

Key responsibilities 

- Audit merchants' online presence: menus, pricing, photos, listings and reviews

- Optimise marketplace listings and promotions to lift revenue on delivery platforms

- Help merchants move loyal guests to their own direct ordering channel

- Monitor merchant performance data and act on opportunities and risks

- Run growth experiments and campaigns for merchant groups

- Share insights with the product team to shape new features

- Work with Merchant Success to turn results into long-term customer relationships and success stories

Requirements

- 3 to 4 years of experience in growth, account management, marketplace operations or e-commerce

- A strong, hands-on understanding of food delivery platforms such as Uber Eats and Just Eat Takeaway: how their algorithms, promotions, fees and rankings work

- Analytical and comfortable with data, spreadsheets and dashboards

- A good understanding of how restaurants work and what drives their revenue

- Fluent in Dutch and English

Benefits

- Salary of €50,000 to €70,000 gross per year, depending on experience

- 25 holiday days plus Dutch public holidays, and 8% holiday allowance

- Working side by side with the team at our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre

- Personal development budget and direct access to an experienced leadership team

- Laptop and the tools you need to do your best work

- An ambitious team of food lovers, great lunches and the occasional canal trip

title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)

The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch.

- Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you.

- Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see.

- Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken.

- Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months.

- Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance.

- Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite.

title: Production Planner
description:
At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

Taken

The opportunity 
Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations.

This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment

In this role, you will be responsible for 

- Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives.

- Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability.

- Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc.

- Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment.

- Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions.

- Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities.

- Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis.

- Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership.

- Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles).

- Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively.

Vereisten

You’ll bring: 

- Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required).

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required).

- Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required).

- Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

- Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach.

- Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules.

- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

- High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Benefits

What Harvey provides: 
Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer

- a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,-

- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn

- an in-house fitness center

- 26 vacation days

- several fun company outings and parties each year

- Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites

title: Business Developer B2B & Retail
description:
Bij de meeste salesbanen stopt je werk bij de afspraak. Bij MarketLeap begint het daar pas.

Ik ben Luc, mede-oprichter van MarketLeap. Wij zijn het externe salesteam van online gepositioneerde merken met een fysiek product. Onze klanten verkopen o.a. stoomreinigers, elektrische scooters, spark machines, pilates-reformers, stoelviltdoppen en autopoetsmiddelen. Wij zorgen dat die producten bij grote retailketens, groothandels en distributeurs terechtkomen, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Niet met alleen een lijst aan leads of een ingeplande afspraak, maar met een getekende deal en een product in het schap.

Onze merken vind je terug bij de Makro, Coolblue, Albert Heijn, Decathlon, Praxis, Karwei, Bouwmaat, Welkoop, Intratuin, MediaMarkt, Intersport, Sport2000, en we zitten aan tafel met grote internationale distribiteurs. Dat zijn dus niet alleen logo's op onze site, dat zijn concrete deals die ons team heeft gerealiseerd. We bestaan sinds 2023, hebben ruim 140 klanttrajecten gedraaid en zijn winstgevend. We zoeken per direct versterking van één a twee business developers voor ons team van zes business developers en twee founders in Utrecht.

Taken

Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Voor elk merk maak je een projectplan met heldere targets, zoek je de juiste afnemers, vindt je de beslissers, belt, mailt, plant de afspraak, voert het gesprek, maakt het voorstel en onderhandelt tot de handtekening. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou.

Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant.

Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Het repeterende werk, zoals leadlijsten bouwen, research op een keten en de eerste opzet van een pitchdeck, hebben we in Claude Cowork geautomatiseerd met eigen skills. Jij werkt met HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo, Lusha, Notion en Claude, zodat je tijd gaat naar het voeren van gesprekken en closen van deals.

Hoe je start: 

In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht.

Vereisten

- 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. 

- Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. 

- Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor.

- Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe.

- Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier.

- 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. 

- Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is.

Benefits

- Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.

- De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond.

- Extra bonussen bij grote wins.

- Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer.

- 25 vakantiedagen

- Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk.

- Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend.

- Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis.

- Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel.

Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan.

Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap

Your Role 

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making. 

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

What will keep you challenged? 

- Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

- Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

- Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

- Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

- Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

- Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure

What you bring 

- Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

- Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

- Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

- Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

- FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

title: Financial Controller (w/m/d)
description:
Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Kryptowährungen, Stablecoins und anderen tokenisierten Vermögenswerten) in Blockchain-Netzwerken. Unsere Lösung wird bereits von mehr als 50 institutionellen Kunden eingesetzt. Als lizenziertes Finanzinstitut wird die Tangany GmbH von der BaFin reguliert.

Für unser anhaltendes Wachstum suchen wir einen Financial Controller (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.

Das Team ist klein. Deine Expertise und dein Beitrag wirken sich unmittelbar aus: Du arbeitest mit unserer Accountant und unserer Steuerkanzlei z.B. an Themen wie Finanzbuchhaltung, Lohn und Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung; die formale Verantwortung für das Rechnungswesen liegt bei der Geschäftsleitung, Zahlungen geben wir im Vier-Augen-Prinzip frei. In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.

Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.

Heute arbeiten wir vor allem mit DATEV Unternehmen Online und Tableau. Die Steuerung darauf baust du zu großen Teilen neu auf, gern AI-gestützt: Unser AI-Dev-Team setzt mit dir Live-Reporting, Abstimmungen und ein Finanz-Cockpit um.

Aufgaben

- Den Jahresabschluss nach HGB und RechKredV erstellen, ergänzt um die RechZahlV-Posten für unser Zahlungsgeschäft, und die Prüfung gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und Abschlussprüfer durchführen.

- Das aufsichtsrechtliche Meldewesen führen und Finanzinformationen nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben unter Begleitung des Compliance-Teams bereitstellen.

title: Senior Technical Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

As a Senior Technical Customer Success Manager at GeneralMind, the customer is yours after the first pitch onwards - through the close, the rollout, and everything that follows. You work at the core of our go-to-market, side by side with the founders, marketing, product, and sales ops, refining how we sell and keeping the pace high.

You join a small, ambitious team and help define how we win customers and grow them across international markets. Whether you come from a generalist background or have years of selling behind you matters less than this: you pick things up quickly, you are comfortable with complex problems, and you can explain value in plain terms.

The job sits where AI, SaaS, and operational excellence (supply chain, for example) meet. You will use AI tools in your daily work and get noticeably better at your job because of it.

What you will do

- Take ownership of the customer after the first pitch and carry the relationship through close, integration, and later expansion.

- Build lasting relationships with C-level executives and their teams inside large, complex enterprises.

- Lead customers through deep dives and product Go-Lives, then keep the relationship growing over time.

- Develop a thorough understanding of what our customers struggle with, particularly in operational areas such as supply chain.

- Work closely with product engineers and founders, bringing what you hear in the market back into messaging, strategy, and roadmap.

- Keep the pipeline clean and the forecast accurate in our CRM.

- Help shape our product and go-to-market strategy, and keep testing, learning, and improving how you work.

What we are looking for

- 3-8 years of professional experience in a demanding setting: top-tier management consulting, venture capital or growth equity, a fast-moving high-growth startup, or B2B SaaS / enterprise software sales.

- Driven and quick to learn, with an appetite for complexity. You want to build rather than just execute, and you take responsibility early.

- Able to grasp complex products and business processes fast and explain their value clearly to buyers without a technical background.

- A structured, analytical, and highly proactive way of working.

- Someone who gets their hands dirty. Nobody here is above any task, and that is a big part of why we move fast.

- Real curiosity about AI tools and the willingness to make them part of how you work. Excited to help define what modern, AI-driven go-to-market looks like.

- Keen to become a top commercial operator, whether or not you have a classic sales background.

- Strong academic record. A well-regarded university is a plus.

- Excellent communication skills in German and English. Additional languages are a plus.

title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
description:
About us

Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results.

Project description (TUM Project)

This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact.

The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice.

Objectives of the project study

- to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand),

- to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective,

- to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results,

- to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect.

Main task and methodology

Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling.

Student requirements

Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Strong results open the door to a next conversation with Mediacharge.

Project scope and application

Preferred scope: 3 months in three phases: Explore, Analyse, Build

Number of students: 3–5

title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
description:
01 · Why this role exists

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. 

Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet.

That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes.

02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together

I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/

03 · What you'll do

- Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself.

- Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network.

- Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no.

- Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets.

- Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials.

- Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships.

04 · What you bring

- Experience: You've worked in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, and you know how to approach technical profiles.

- People sense: You spot potential even when it's not on the CV, and you talk to engineers as equals.

- Tech affinity: You try out new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster.

- Builder drive: You don't want to step into ready-made structures – you want to create them, independently, reliably and fast.

- Background: A degree in psychology, business, HR, social sciences or similar – or a path that prepared you just as well.

- Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

05 · What you get

- Performance counts: Uncapped variable pay plus equity – good work is visible here and rewarded directly.

- Real ownership: You're the first recruiter. What you build stays.

- A network that moves you forward: Sparring, mentoring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird.

- Once a year, we get out: A team workation with everyone, including conversations with inspiring guests like Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo or James Vincent.

- Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership.

- Münster office: You sit right next to our engineering team – the people you'll hire most – and you hear first-hand what makes a great engineer at RIZM. Recruiting thrives on short distances – the best ideas come up at the same table.

06 · How to apply

You don't need to write a classic cover letter. We don't think it tells us much about a person anymore. 

Instead, picture this: a few years from now, RIZM welcomes its 100th team member. There's a celebration in the Münster office. One of the first people you ever hired stands up to say a few words.

- What's the one thing you hope they say about you?

- And what have you done so far that makes you believe they would?

A few honest sentences are enough.

title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch) 

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht 

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check 

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du… 

- … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst , die es wirklich braucht.

- … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren. 

- … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest .

- … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht .

- … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben . Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du 

Worum geht es? 

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist? 

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI? 

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben? 

- Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

- Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

- Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

- Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support 

- Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

- Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann.

- Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik.

Was bringst du mit? 

- 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

- Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

- Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB.

- Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

- Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss 

- Erfahrung mit WordPress.

- Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch.

- Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden.

Rahmenbedingungen 

- Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes

- Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb

- Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht.

- Zeitraum: ab sofort

Interesse? 

Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung.

Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr.

Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima.

Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung.

Unser Team, deine Vorteile 

Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt.

Das sind unsere Vorteile:

- Fort- und Weiterbildung

- Family Life Balance

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Homeoffice

- Freiwillige Sozial­leistungen

- Urban Sports Club

Lust auf mehr? Unser Team stellt sich dir gerne persönlich vor.

title: Junior Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Mammutmarsch heißt Abenteuer. Mammutmarsch heißt Grenzen sprengen. Wir sind die Bewegung hinter den Extremwanderungen, die Menschen motiviert, über sich hinauszuwachsen. Du bringst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing Team Mammutmarsch in UK an den Start – von lokalen Marketingideen bis zu ersten Kampagnen und Partnerschaften. Du bringst dein Marktverständnis ein, setzt Maßnahmen eigenständig um und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten echte Resonanz in der Community wird.

Remote‑first, pragmatisch, hands‑on. Wir entscheiden nah am Ziel, testen schnell, lernen noch schneller und setzen mutige Ideen um – mit Teamgeist, Kreativität, klarer Kommunikation und Verantwortung.

Was du mitbringst

- Reisebereitschaft für punktuelle UK‑Aktivitäten

- Begeisterung für unsere Mission und Events

Unser Versprechen an dich 

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketing‑Kernteam

- Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und schneller Impact

- Flexible, remote Zusammenarbeit (Freelance oder in Teilzeit 15–20 Std./Woche)

- Faire Vergütung, klare Ziele, kurze Entscheidungswege

- Chance, Mammutmarsch in UK von Beginn an mit aufzubauen

Deine Bewerbung 

Klingt nach dir? Schick uns deinen CV/Portfolio und 2–3 kurze Beispiele deiner Arbeit (z. B. Posts, Kampagnen) plus ein paar Zeilen, warum UK dein Spielfeld ist. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von vier Tagen bei dir.

title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth. 

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios. 

As a Senior Fraud Analyst , you'll join our Fraud Analytics team as a close partner to our Fraud Analytics Team Lead - someone who can operate independently, mentor other team members, and help shape the fraud and risk agenda as the team and company scale. 

You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. It's a highly visible, high-ownership role in a fast-growing company. 

What You'll Own:

- Strategic partnership: Partner directly with the Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategy, ideation, and day-to-day problem solving - acting as a sounding board, ready to step in and keep things moving when needed.

- Reporting uplift: Drive the evolution of fraud and risk reporting, turning raw data into sharp, decision-ready insights.

- Fraud trend analysis: Hunt down patterns across our user base, shape the detection logic and rules that keep us ahead of bad actors, monitor how those rules perform, and optimise them over time.

- Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet.

- Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies.

- Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales.

- Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on.

What You Bring

- Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry.

- Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting.

- Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting.

- Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas.

- Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives.

- Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).

- Language: Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

- Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks.

- Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM.

- Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed.

How We Win

- Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

- Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

- See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

- Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

- Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

title: GTM Associate
description:
GTM Associate 

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth.

About Vega 

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are 

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it 

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

- We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

- We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

- We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

- We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

- We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role 

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

- Be a client’s first touchpoint with Vega - this means being a credible counterpart to senior people at multi-billion dollar managers

- Work directly with the Head of Strategy and Growth and the CEO to find angles and drive deals forward from start to close

- Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation: targeting, outbound, qualification, and building the systems around this motion

- Help build the commercial playbook as you go: taking an operational and systematic lens to turn learnings into a discipline that the team can follow

- Support the broader growth surface: events, partnerships, content, and marketing

What we look for: 

- 2+ years in investor relations / finance, MBB, or a commercial/operational role at a fast-paced startup

- Experience in private markets, particularly around investor relations workflows, is a strong plus

- Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, as well as analytical instincts

- Genuine tolerance for repetition and rejection - this is some of the highest impact work you can do for the company, but it’s also high volume and requires scrappiness

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills when interfacing with clients who have a very high standard for output and attention to detail

- Creativity and a bias to action, particularly when supporting with broader growth/marketing topics

Why join us? 

- You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

The Role 
You will own specific Linux systems supporting our NATO delivery on AWS, from configuration and monitoring to upgrades and incident response. You will be the specialist the team escalates to when a fault defeats first-line troubleshooting, and you will improve reliability as well as restore it. 

You will mentor Systems Administrators in troubleshooting and operational hygiene. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Systems Administration Manager, with a clear technical path to Lead Systems Administrator. 

What You Will Do 

- Own one or more systems or environments, covering configuration, monitoring and alerting, upgrades and incident response. 

- Debug difficult faults, including performance problems, resource exhaustion and integration failures, and take each incident from first symptom to a root cause and a remediation plan that holds. 

- Configure and tune services with secure, hardened defaults, and turn scan output and logs into lasting remediation. 

- Plan and execute upgrades and changes under change control, with realistic risk assessment and a tested rollback. 

- Act as the escalation point for Systems Administrator colleagues, mentor them, and document patterns others can reuse in runbooks and standard operating procedures. 

- Work across engineering, cyber and data teams on cross-functional problems. 

- Take part in UK operational coverage, including on-call rotation and structured handovers with the US team. 

What You Bring 

- Strong hands-on Linux systems administration in complex, secure production environments, with depth in service behaviour, performance tuning and hardened configuration. Experience on Microsoft Azure, VMware vSphere or similar platforms is transferable. 

- Sound networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and routing, and hands-on identity and access management across directory services and cloud platforms. 

- Working experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker or Packer, and with patching discipline and configuration compliance in an accredited environment.
