title: Senior GTM System Builder
description:
Help make the world more hospitable 

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.

You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.

What you would do 

- Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion

- Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up

- Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start

- Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment

- Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions

- Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod

AI Fluency Level 4: In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 

What you would bring 

- 4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets

- Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes

- Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience

- Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems

- Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running

- Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have 

- Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version

- Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations

- Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaking
description:
About ROLLER 

ROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. With a global presence in over 30 countries, we're here to bring some excitement to the leisure and attractions industry and make a difference! Our mission is to help businesses operate smoothly and create fun and memorable guest experiences by providing seamless ticketing, point-of-sale, self-serve kiosks, memberships and digital waiver processes.

But here's the best part: our team. We're a group of 300+ highly passionate, enthusiastic, and down-to-earth professionals located all around the world who are all working together to build something truly remarkable. We're aiming high and believe that the possibilities are endless. As we continue to grow globally, we're excited to write our success story and have fun along the way.

We genuinely love what we do, and we're looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team and make a real impact, come aboard, and let's create some unforgettable experiences together at ROLLER!

About the Role 

The Solution Engineer owns the end-to-end pre-sales process at ROLLER, commercial and technical. You partner with Account Executives to qualify, progress, and earn new business, while simultaneously running the technical validation that gives prospects the confidence to buy.

What sets a ROLLER SE apart is the combination. You carry the commercial rigour of a quota-carrying rep; MEDDICC discipline, value-based discovery, and business case ownership alongside the technical credibility to design and deliver compelling solutions. On the most complex deals, you'll have access to a Solution Architect as a force multiplier, which frees you to stay focused on the commercial motion where you create the most value.

In this role you will support ROLLER's growth across the French market, engaging prospects and customers in French while collaborating with our wider EMEA and global teams in English.

What You’ll Do 

- Champion MEDDICC qualification across your pipeline: identifying Economic Buyers, mapping Decision Criteria and Process, surfacing Implicated Pain, and maintaining a clear, honest view of deal health at all times

- Lead technical & value based discovery with prospects, diagnosing operational and revenue pain points and connecting them explicitly to the value ROLLER delivers

- Own the technical pre-sales process: running tailored product demonstrations, managing technical validation, and handling integration and configuration questions across the standard deal motion

- In support with the AE, and our Business Value Consultant, present ROI-led business cases framed in the language of the Economic Buyer; revenue growth, cost reduction, and operational efficiency, not feature lists

The opportunity

You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to.

You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship. A dedicated level editor and an AI-powered level generation pipeline will be ready on day one, so you spend your time on what matters: making every level fun.

What you’ll do

- Build. Design, build, and tune levels directly in Unity, covering layouts, encounters, pacing and difficulty.
- Scale. Triple our level content by combining our AI pipeline with your own design judgment.
- Balance. Model how health, damage, and stat changes affect the numbers before anything ships.
- Polish. Bring existing levels to final quality and give them the feel and juice that make players stay.
- Own. Set the level design roadmap, make design calls, and question whether each choice fits the game.
- Specify. Write clear, detailed specs that developers can implement as written.
- Learn from players. Use playtests and player data to see what works and iterate quickly.
- AI. Use AI every day to generate layouts, prototype encounters, simulate balancing, and automate level work.
Requirements 

- Years of level design experience, with shipped levels on a hybrid casual, RPG or combat-based game.
- Hands-on balancing skills: you’re comfortable with stats, health and damage maths, and spreadsheets.
- Fluency in Unity: you build and iterate levels in the engine yourself.
- A strong sense of game feel: you know when a level is fun, and you can explain why.
- AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
- The autonomy to build your own roadmap and make design decisions.
- A data-driven approach to level tuning.
- Feature design experience alongside level design.
For this role, you’ll also bring

- Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
- Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
- Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
- Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. 
- Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious, high-energy, and grounded.

- Real ownership. You own the player experience of a game, and you’ll see your levels move the metrics.

- A high talent bar. Our teams are small and ambiti us, and the people around you will push you to grow.
- AI at the core. You’ll have access to the best AI tools, and you’ll help shape how level design works in an AI-first company.
Benefits 

At Homa , we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
- Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. 

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. 

Cas d’étude 

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.

Profil recherché

Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.

Type de contrat

Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy working across the full IoT stack? In this role you’ll design embedded firmware for low-power devices, connect them through BLE, LoRa or Cellular, and build the cloud architecture and fleet management systems that run them at scale.

You’ll work closely with firmware, hardware and cloud colleagues, shape our CI/CD pipelines, and help improve how we build and deploy as we grow. It’s a hands-on role for someone who likes variety and wants to see their work running in real shipments.

📍 Location: We need you to be within commutable distance to Basel given the role requires 50%+ time spent on-site.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell? 

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do: 

- Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal)

- Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular

- Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments

- Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations

- Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions)

- Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams

- Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers

- Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices

What You'll Bring: 

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART)

- Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON)

- Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

- Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

- Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken German and English

If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you. 

What's In It For You? 

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above. 

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact? 

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell 

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing 

- Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract

- Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer

- Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE

- Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases

- Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers

- Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders

- Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)

- Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for 

- A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience

- 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company

- A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets

- Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written

- Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH

- A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking

- Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC

- Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools

- Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus

- Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work 

- Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.

- A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.

- Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions .

- Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

- Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the results.

Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

- The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
description:
L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur.

Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire.

Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F .

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison.

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

- Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
- Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
- Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.
- Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH.
- Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés.
- Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture.
- Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif.

- Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
- Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.

Profil :

- Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines .
- Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration .
- Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire.
- Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales .
- Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.
- Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers.
- Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH.
- Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles.
- Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout.
- Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive.

Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison.

title: Content & Social Growth Manager:in (80–100 %)
description:
Was bluu bewegt

Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen.
Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.

Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich. 
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

- Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

- Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

- Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

- Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

- E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle. 
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

- neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

- Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

- neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

- mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

- nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

- Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

- Du filmst und schneidest selbst, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere oder vergleichbaren Tools

- Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

- erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

- Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

- Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

- echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

- ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

- Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

- ein Büro mitten in Zürich, Homeoffice bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche

- bis zu zwei Wochen pro Jahr arbeitest du, von wo du möchtest

- enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem ganzen Team, auch bei neuen Produktideen

- viel Raum für eigene Ideen: Wenn etwas Sinn macht, probieren wir es aus

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten) 
Erzähl uns:

- was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

- Warum genau du perfekt für die Stelle passt

- wo du aktuell den grössten Hebel für bluu siehst

- eine konkrete Content-Idee für @bluuwash

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio 
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

Wichtig: Verlinke dein Video oder dein Portfolio direkt in deinem CV, zum Beispiel über YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive oder deine eigene Website.

Wir suchen keine Person, die Content nur plant.
Wir suchen jemanden, der einen Trend morgens sieht, ihn am Nachmittag umsetzt und am nächsten Tag weiss, ob er funktioniert hat.

title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description:
Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

- Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

- Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

- Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

- Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

- Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

- Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

- Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

- Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

- Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

- Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

- Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

- Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

- Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

- Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

- The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

- Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

- Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

- Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

- Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

- A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

- Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

- Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

- Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

- Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

- Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

- Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

- Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

- Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

- Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

- Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

- Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

- Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

- Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

- Profile review and short phone screen

- Take-home case study

- Case discussion with the ML team

- On-site interview and team evaluation

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

- Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

- Experience running qualification programs for materials used in pyrotechnic or energetic systems.

Ben jij servicegericht, communicatief sterk en krijg jij energie van het helpen van klanten? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als klantenservice medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en zorg jij elke dag weer voor een uitstekende servicebeleving.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Als klantenservice medewerker ben je hét online visitekaartje van Giga Meubel. Je staat klanten te woord via e-mail, chat en telefoon (dagelijks van 10-12 uur) en zorgt ervoor dat iedere vraag of klacht helder en professioneel wordt afgehandeld. Geen gesprek is hetzelfde en juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk leuk.

- Je achterhaalt snel de kern van vragen en klachten

- Je denkt in oplossingen en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende systemen

- Je communiceert duidelijk met klanten én zorgt voor een goede interne terugkoppeling

- Je werkt zelfstandig, maar denkt ook actief mee met de organisatie

Je werkt met AFAS en Microsoft Office. De klantenservice is geopend van maandag t/m vrijdag van 08:30 tot 21:00 uur en op zaterdag van 08:30 tot 17:00 uur. Tijdens de zomermaanden van mei tot september is de klantenservice tot 20 uur geopend. Je werkt in wisselende diensten binnen deze openingstijden: 8:30-17 uur of 12:30-21 uur.

Vereisten

Wie ben jij? 
✓ Je hebt een sterke persoonlijkheid met een positieve mindset

✓ Je hebt mbo werk- en -denkniveau

✓ Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en hebt een goede kennis van het Engels

✓ Je typt snel en foutloos en bent handig met computers

✓ Je kunt je heel goed inleven in situaties en denkt altijd oplossingsgericht

✓ Je bent flexibel, houdt van verandering en wilt écht het verschil maken

✓ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar binnen de openingstijden van de klantenservice: ma-vr 8:30-17 uur, 12:30-21 uur en za 8:30-17 uur en je werkt gemiddeld 1-2 avonden per week en 1 keer per 3 weken op de zaterdag
✓ Je bent op korte termijn beschikbaar en woont in (de omgeving van) Barneveld

Benefits

Wat bieden wij jou als klantenservice medewerker? 
✓ Een fulltime, veelzijdige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid
✓ Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring
✓ Gunstige werktijden, reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenbijdrage en personeelskorting
✓ Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de functie en organisatie
✓ Een informele, fijne werksfeer binnen een jong en groeiend bedrijf
✓ Vrijdagmiddagborrels en gezellige teamuitjes
✓ Een goed bereikbare werkplek: ons kantoor ligt op 5 minuten fietsen van station Barneveld-Centrum

Onze bedrijfscultuur Bij Giga Meubel werk je in een informele, no-nonsense omgeving waar iedereen een steentje bijdraagt aan het succes van ons familiebedrijf. We zijn jong, internationaal actief en houden van een gezonde balans: we werken hard, maar maken ook veel plezier samen.

Enthousiast en klaar om aan de slag te gaan? 
Zie jij jezelf al aan de slag gaan als klantenservice medewerker bij Giga Meubel? Ben jij net zo enthousiast als wij? Solliciteer dan nu! Stuur je motivatie en cv naar ons en wij nemen binnen 2 werkdagen contact met je op. Geen lange procedures; we houden van snel schakelen!

title: (Senior) Principal Mendix Developer
description:
Excited to lead teams and architect Mendix solutions that are scalable, future-ready and make a real difference? 

At Valcon, we help organisations across Europe become fit for the future – combining consulting, data and technology to realise real transformation. We work end-to-end: from boardroom strategy to concrete implementation on the work floor. Our approach is pragmatic, fast and collaborative. No buzzwords, just results.

Our culture is defined by ownership, entrepreneurship and continuous learning. We believe in growing together – through mentorship, trust and the freedom to shape your own path. We offer flexibility, challenge, and the opportunity to work on projects that matter.

You’ll join our fast-growing Low-Code capability, with over 100 Mendix professionals across Europe – including 26 experts and 3 MVPs in the Netherlands alone. Our team works on high-impact projects for clients like IND/COA, Prorail, Defensie, BAM, Heineken with a strong focus on collaboration, quality and long-term solutions. Many of our projects are international – such as our recent engagement in Denmark, where our hybrid team (NL, DK, KR) delivers scalable solutions from design to delivery. Whether you want to specialise, coach others or lead engagements: you’ll find the space and support to grow.

Tasks

What will you do? 

As a (Senior) Principal Mendix Consultant, you bring together strategic thinking, platform expertise and strong leadership. You’ll lead multidisciplinary project or DevOps teams with full end-to-end ownership – from uncovering client needs to delivering scalable, future-ready applications.

You take the lead in workshops, architecture and design decisions, translating complex business challenges into impactful IT-solutions – ranging from mobile and workflow apps to data-driven and integrated platforms. Increasingly, you’ll work on solutions that leverage AI, smart automation and advanced integrations to unlock new business value.

Beyond delivery, you’ll play a key role in shaping our Low-Code capability. You help scale teams, raise engineering standards, and contribute to strategy, talent development and internal best practices. As a technical lead, you’re also actively involved in pre-sales, shaping proposals and leading proof-of-concepts for new clients.

Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path. 

Among your responsibilities will be the following: 

- Designing, developing and testing innovative Mendix solutions in an agile way.

- Leading multidisciplinary teams and acting as technical lead in delivery projects: guiding architecture, workshops, design decisions, and quality

- Leading and coaching multiple Mendix teams, sometimes across different clients and domains.

- Tackling complex technical challenges and shaping long-term platform strategies.

- Coaching developers and consultants to grow their skills and confidence with the Mendix platform.

- Supporting pre-sales activities and helping shape client proposals and proof-of-concepts.

- Strengthening our Low-Code capability through improved standards, best practices and strategic team development.

Requirements

Experience: 

- A completed Bachelor’s, Master’s or technical HBO degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics or a related field.

- At least 4 years of working experience as Mendix specialist/application developer and Mendix Advanced Developer certification.

- Nice to have: Mendix Expert Developer Certification and/or a specialisation in a domain like UI/UX, Architecture or custom (react/java) development.

- Fluent in Dutch and English

- Located in The Netherlands

Benefits

What do we offer you? 

- Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

- An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

- Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

- Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer: 

- Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.

- A company car or mobility budget.

- A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

- An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

- The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

- A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

Ready to apply? 

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

title: Senior Java/Kotlin Engineer
description:
Bij Creetion bouw je mee aan een sterke Java/Kotlin-community. Een plek waar vakmanschap de norm is, kennisdeling vanzelfsprekend, en jij de ruimte krijgt om te excelleren met collega’s die je inhoudelijk beter maken. Geen hype, geen snelle groei. Wel een cultuur waarin je serieus genomen wordt en impact maakt op projecten die ertoe doen. 

Sluit jij je aan bij een engineering cultuur die je uitdaagt en beter maakt? 

Taken

Je werkt aan complexe, cloud‑native oplossingen voor toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland. In omgevingen waar schaalbaarheid, security en performance core business zijn. Je hebt invloed op architectuurkeuzes en werkt in teams waar kwaliteit boven buzzwords gaat.

Zo maak jij impact

- Ontwerp en bouw high-performance, cloud-native services met Spring Boot in Java 21+ en/of Kotlin.

- Werk met event-driven architecturen waarin dagelijks (honderden) miljoenen events worden verwerkt.

- Richt CI/CD‑pipelines in en deploy via GitOps met Kubernetes en ArgoCD op Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Neem eigenaarschap over architectuur, performance en reliability (SLO’s/SLA’s, resilience-patterns, idempotency, backpressure).

- Observeer en optimaliseer met metrics/logging/tracing (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry) en security‑by‑design (OAuth2/OIDC, secrets, policies).

- Versnel met agentic AI zoals Claude, Cursor en Junie.

- Deel kennis actief binnen onze community en bij klanten.

Vereisten

Wat breng je mee? 

- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer (hbo/wo of aantoonbaar gelijkwaardig niveau).

- Sterke kennis van Java (21+) en/of Kotlin.

- Ervaring met Spring Boot, cloud-native development en event-driven architectuur.

- Bekend met Kubernetes en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines d.m.v. GitOps.

- Ervaring met Kafka of vergelijkbare messaging-technologieën.

- Ervaring met AWS, Azure, of GCP.

- Pluspunt: kennis van frontend frameworks zoals Angular of React voor full-stack eigenaarschap.

- Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en bent communicatief sterk. 

- Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en kunt technische keuzes, op verschillende niveaus, helder uitleggen.

Benefits

- Keuzevrijheid in beloning:

- Vast salaris: €5.000 – €8.000 + bonus

- Of een aantrekkelijke 70/30-regeling

- Jij kiest hoe je reist: Goede leaseregeling of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Hybride werken.

- Investering in jouw groei: Ruim opleidingsbudget en toegang tot conferenties.

- Een echte engineering community: Collega’s die precies weten wat er speelt in de markt.

- Goede basis: Pensioen en collectieve verzekeringen.

- Projecten die ertoe doen: Kritische systemen in fintech, energie, infrastructuur en overheid.

Wat maakt ons anders? 

- Engineering‑led leadership: Onze richting wordt bepaald door ervaren engineers die zelf nog dagelijks coderen en spreken op internationale conferenties. Keuzes zijn inhoudelijk, niet politiek.

- Samen naar conferenties: We gaan samen naar conferenties en meetups. Heb je de ambitie om te spreken? We helpen je d.m.v. coaching, dry‑runs en reviews.

- We nemen jou serieus: Geen “superhero’s”, “ninjas” of “wizards”. Jij bent een professional. Je krijgt vertrouwen, autonomie en echte inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

- Opdrachtkeuzes maken we samen: Projecten waar je trots op bent, gebaseerd op jouw groeipad.

- Een echte engineering cultuur: Een community die je uitdaagt én beter maakt.

- Bewuste schaal: Korte lijnen, directe invloed. Jouw stem weegt.

Waarom je bij ons past 

Je wilt werken aan systemen die niet mogen falen, met collega’s die kwaliteit serieus nemen. Je zoekt autonomie, vertrouwen en een stem in technische keuzes. Dat is precies wat je hier krijgt, in een community die je uitdaagt én beter maakt.

Klaar om het verschil te maken? 

Laat je werk spreken. Deel je GitHub, LinkedIn of cv en laat ons zien waar je trots op bent: een repo, een architectuurschets of een interessante trade-off die je onlangs maakte.

title: Marketplace specialist die scoort, niet alleen beheert
description:
Ben jij klaar om productinformatie om te zetten in verkoopsucces en daarmee de marketplaces te veroveren? 

World of Alps – REHALL outerwear en Kampeerwinkel Roermond ontwikkelen en verkopen, hoogwaardige outdoor-winter-en adventure producten, aan klanten die het hele jaar door actief onderweg zijn. We zijn nog maar net vertrokken, versterken onze positie in Nederland en tevens zetten we de eerste stappen richting Europa.

Onze ambities? Groot. We willen op toonaangevende marketplaces zoals Amazon, Bol en Decathlon echt zichtbaar worden. Daarbij kan jij een cruciale rol gaan vervullen.

Als Marketplace Specialist til jij onze performance naar een hoger niveau. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze producten niet alleen gezien worden, maar ook verkocht en gekocht worden. Je optimaliseert listings, stuurt op voorraad en pricing, en duikt in data om commerciële kansen te spotten en te pakken. Van content tot conversie, jij weet wat werkt.

Samen met onze marketing, product, customer service en operations zorg je ervoor dat we groeien: nieuwe producten ontwikkelen, nieuwe markten aanboren, nieuwe kansen zoeken en vinden. Jouw impact moet direct zichtbaar worden binnen ons gezamenlijke resultaat.

Taken

- Beheren en optimaliseren van listings op diverse marktplaatsen, inclusief titels, beschrijvingen, beelden, SEO en pricing.

- Monitoren van prestaties (traffic, conversie, ranking, retourpercentages) en gericht optimaliseren op basis van data).

- Aansturen en verbeteren van de productinformatievoorziening in samenwerking met product management.

- Opzetten en beheren van campagnes binnen marktplaatsplatformen (advertising, deals, promoties).

- Bewaken van voorraadposities, levertijden en order control processen. 

- Analyseren van concurrentie en marktkansen om groei te versnellen.

- Signaleren van trends en kansen binnen marketplaces en proactief initiatieven voorstellen.

- Oplossen van operationele issues zoals listing errors, account health en klantvragen.

- Rapporteren van resultaten en verbeterkansen.

Vereisten

- Je hebt ervaring met marketplaces (Bol, Amazon of vergelijkbare platformen).

- Ervaring met bijv. Channable, EffectConnect of vergelijkbare systemen is een plus.

- Je werkt gestructureerd, bent analytisch sterk en handelt doelgericht.

- Je weet commerciële kansen te herkennen én benutten.

- Je hebt affiniteit met e-commerce, productdata en conversieoptimalisatie.

- Je communiceert helder en werkt graag samen met verschillende afdelingen.

- Je bent fulltime 40 uur beschikbaar.

Benefits

- Een plek in een ervaren team, waar iedereen iets toevoegt. Succes maak je samen.

- Jezelf ontwikkelen en steeds uit blijven dagen.

- Uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren.

- Collega’s waarbij teamwork en collegialiteit van groot belang zijn.

- Een goed salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring.

- 25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

- Reiskostenvergoeding à € 0.23, – per km (maximaal 40 km een enkele reis).

- Informele werksfeer met vrijdagmiddagborrels, personeelsfeest en kerstborrel.

- Op vrijdag sluiten we de week af met een drankje in onze eigen bar.

Waarom je bij ons wilt werken 

Sluit je aan als Marketplace Specialist en word onderdeel van onze digitale groei-ambities. We zijn geen corporate met eindeloze overleggen, bij ons draait het om doen. Je komt terecht in een hands-on team dat niet bang is om te experimenteren, te leren en snel te schakelen.

We bouwen aan merken die internationaal steeds meer terrein winnen. De komende jaren schalen we op in meerdere Europese markten: Duitsland, België, Oostenrijk en verder. Jij speelt daar een sleutelrol in. Je krijgt de vrijheid om processen te professionaliseren, strategieën uit te testen en échte impact te maken op onze marketplace-performance. Denk aan: optimaliseren van productfeeds, experimenteren met pricing-strategieën, A/B-testen van content, en het opzetten van campagnes die converteren.

Dit is geen standaard 9-tot-5 job waar je vastloopt in procedures. Je werkt nauw samen met marketing, product en operations, en je ideeën worden serieus genomen. Zie je een kans? Dan pak je 'm. Spot je een probleem? Dan los je het op. Jouw impact is direct zichtbaar in onze cijfers en daar worden we allemaal enthousiast van.

Ready to join? 

Ben je klaar om mee te bouwen aan een merk met internationale ambitie? Iemand die niet alleen wil uitvoeren, maar ook wil meedenken over waar we naartoe gaan? Stuur ons je CV en vertel in je motivatie waarom jij dé persoon bent die onze marketplace-strategie naar het volgende niveau tilt.

We maken graag persoonlijk kennis, zonder corporate gedoe, gewoon een goed gesprek over hoe jij een sleutelrol kunt spelen in onze Europese expansie. En wie weet zit je over een paar weken al midden in je eerste marketplace-optimalisatie.

title: IT Project & Delivery Management Consultant (Experienced)
description:
At Valcon, we’re looking for experienced professionals to drive high-stakes IT delivery initiatives, optimise digital strategies, and mentor the next generation of consultants. Do you have a passion for IT and business? 

As an ITPDM Consultant at Valcon, you will play a key role in helping clients achieve their strategic goals through innovative IT solutions.

At Valcon, we don’t just implement technology. We redefine how businesses operate with it. We combine strategy, execution, and technology expertise to create lasting impact for our clients. As part of our IT Project & Delivery Management (ITPDM) capability, you will lead large-scale IT delivery programs, design and implement modern IT solutions, and help clients navigate their unique technology challenges. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure that solutions are tailored to the client’s specific needs and deliver real business value.

Taken

What will you do? 

Your week as an ITPDM Consultant is dynamic and varied. You might spend one day at the client’s office, running workshops to align business needs with IT solutions. Another day, you could be analysing data and collaborating with your team at Valcon HQ or working from home to prepare reports and refine solution designs. Every few weeks, you join a collaboration day at the Valcon office to connect with colleagues, share updates, and learn from each other. Throughout the week, you’ll engage with stakeholders, contribute to project deliverables, and help drive impactful IT strategies.

At Valcon, we value flexibility. You work where you can make the most impact for our clients.

Your responsibilites will include (but not be limited to): 

- Lead complex IT delivery programs, ensuring alignment with the client’s strategic goals.

- Design and deliver end-to-end IT solutions, from architecture to implementation.

- Develop technology departments by building capabilities and implementing governance structures.

- Advise on and implement modern application delivery and data platforms.

- Drive digital transformation by optimising processes and enabling new business models through technology.

- Spot opportunities for new projects and shape them into concrete assignments for Valcon, contributing to the growth of our business.

- Mentor junior consultants, help shape the growth of Valcon’s ITPDM practice, and contribute to thought leadership in the IT consulting space.

No project is the same. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of challenges, from managing multidisciplinary teams to aligning business and IT strategies. Your leadership and expertise will be key to delivering impactful results.

Vereisten

Experience: 

- At least 8 years of relevant work experience in IT project management, business analysis, or consultancy.

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Information Management, or Computer Science).

- Experience in leading teams and managing stakeholders in complex client environments.

- Affinity with technology, such as application development or low-/high-code solutions.

- Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

- Strong leadership skills and a results-driven mindset.

- Experience with agile working and program management methodologies.

Benefits

What do we offer you? 

- Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

- An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

- Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

- Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

- A company car or mobility budget.

title: IT Project & Delivery Management Consultant (Early Career)
description:

Taken

By aligning business and IT, you will help our clients achieve their strategic objectives and drive meaningful change.

Your week as an ITPDM Consultant is dynamic and varied. You might spend one day at the client’s office, running workshops to align business needs with IT solutions. Another day, you could be analysing data and collaborating with your team at Valcon HQ or working from home to prepare reports and refine solution designs. Throughout the week, you’ll engage with stakeholders, contribute to project deliverables, and help drive impactful IT strategies.

Your responsibilites will include (but not be limited to): 

- Transforming business needs into innovative IT solutions by crafting user stories and intuitive designs.

- Analysing and improving business processes to drive digital transformation.

- Supporting the delivery and implementation of IT solutions, from concept to completion.

- Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure successful project outcomes.

- Managing IT delivery projects in agile, hybrid, or traditional environments.

Each project brings unique challenges, giving you the opportunity to develop a broad skill set and make a real impact. Whether you’re facilitating workshops, aligning business and IT, or optimising processes, your work will contribute to achieving the client’s strategic goals.

Experience: 

- A curious and eager-to-learn mindset; you look beyond the obvious.

- 2 to 8 years of relevant work experience in roles such as business analysis, IT consultancy, or project management.

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Information Management, or Computer Science).

- Affinity with IT and technology, such as application development or low-/high-code solutions.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with various stakeholders.

- Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

- Experience with agile working is a plus.

- Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

- An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

- Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

- Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer: 

- Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.

- A company car or mobility budget.

- A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

- An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

- The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

- A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

Ready to apply? 

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values – Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity – resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About the Team 

At AudioEye , we believe access to digital content is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is clear: eliminate every barrier to digital accessibility so that everyone, regardless of ability, can experience the web without limitations.

We are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are driven by purpose and impact. Every challenge we tackle moves us closer to a future where creating accessible experiences is the standard. If you’re looking for meaningful work where you can drive real change, influence how people with disabilities experience the internet, and be part of a mission that matters, AudioEye is the place for you.

About the Role 

The Staff Engineer role helps to drive the technical direction of AudioEye’s platform and tackles complex challenges in digital accessibility. The position is responsible for designing and building large-scale, reliable systems that detect, remediate, and prevent accessibility issues across millions of websites, using AI and agentic development as a core part of how the work gets done. It blends architecture, hands-on development, and technical leadership to ensure systems are secure, scalable, and performant.

This role collaborates closely with the Product and Design teams to deliver systems that create measurable impact for customers and end users. The Staff Engineer mentors junior engineers on the team, helps shape the technical roadmap, and makes decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability. It requires strong ownership, autonomy, and a focus on solving meaningful technical problems at scale.

How you’ll Contribute: 

- Technically lead one or more engineering teams through needs assessment, system design, implementation, and operations automation

- Drive the technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term sustainability

- Partner with Product, Design, and engineers to build systems that help customers respond quickly to risk, while keeping reliability, security, and data consistency high

- Build web-scale systems with strong grounding in service-oriented architecture, data modeling, performance, and end-to-end delivery

- Understand customer and end-user needs and turn them into measurable value

- Own problems across stacks, teams, and roles, with a bias for action

- Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily to design, build, test, and operate software without lowering the quality bar. Delegate to agents, then review, verify, and take accountability for the output

- Evaluate new AI development tools and adopt those that measurably improve delivery

- Mentor and coach engineers on requirements, system design, problem-solving, and practical AI-assisted development, including prompting, context management, and knowing when not to trust the output

- Help define team standards for responsible AI use across code review, testing, security, and data handling

- Find opportunities to build AI capabilities into our products and internal tooling

- Build a culture of quality, high standards, and engineering excellence

Who you are: 

- 10+ years of engineering experience with design, implementation, and operations of critical systems

- Demonstrated success working in cross-functional environments, advocate for tight collaboration between engineering, user experience, and product teams, and are comfortable making engineering and system-level decisions and tradeoffs

- Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including React and Node.js

- Experienced with relational, NoSQL, and document/object storage

- Proven record of solving deep problems in distributed systems and real-time data technologies

- Built and operated secure, compliant, scalable systems behind high-impact user experiences

- Led large projects across multiple teams and mentored both junior and senior engineers

- Collaborate tightly with Product and UX, and are comfortable making system-level tradeoffs

- Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development, with concrete examples of how it changed how you build and ship

- Sound judgment on where AI helps and where it adds risk, and the discipline to validate generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability

- Have coached other engineers, including senior ones, to adopt AI-assisted workflows

- Thrive on autonomy and ownership, and adapt quickly as tools and practices change

- Model good engineering behavior, practices, and processes

Our Values: 

- Relentlessly Prioritize the Customer

- Own Outcomes

- Be Straightforward

- Act Now & Iterate

- Grit

- Decide with Data 

- Hire and Develop A Players

- Be Coachable

- Organize and Plan

- Expect and Embrace Change

Benefits and Perks: 

- Work with a talented but humble team

- Competitive compensation and equity

- Weekly paid family meal

- 401k, medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Flexible PTO Policy

- 15.5 company-paid holidays including Juneteenth, MLK Day and a 1-week company shut down

- To support remote work conditions, AudioEye provides each employee a one-time stipend of $300
